name: Nova
source:
Punk-ass Skateboarder by night, Mysterious Graffiti artist by... even later night. Brace yourselves, cos she's itching to give the San Mazo streets a taste of her art! But what lies behind all that angst? A softer side? A dark past? MORE ANGST? Probably a mix of all three!

Originally a character from the game [url=http://crush-crush.wikia.com/wiki/Nova]Crush Crush[/url].
